data.name: S_SETTINGS_DISABLE_ADB_LIMITATIONS_INFO
data.value: Disables ADB đường dẫn & executable checks. The checks attempt to prevent an unsuspecting người dùng from launching a possibly malicious tệp masquerading as ADB, and include: • Đường dẫn must not be a remote UNC or a symbolic liên kết • Executable must be Authenticode-signed by Google or match pre-defined SHA-256 hash list • Must return a legible version string when executed with --version
